quote: As woke as it gets. Very nice graphics and physics, but the gameplay and characters do not compare to GTA5 and 4. Story is boring and woke.

author: radu1006
quote: The game has nice story and immersive quests. The characters are quite interesting and the atmosphere is very nice. However the combat is completely off. It is very non-enjoyable and leaves a bad taste in your mouth. There is a lot of room for improvement in this are and hopefully it will be fixed in the future.
